description: This file defines the Subunit entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing organizational subunits in a database with properties like id, name, description, and nested set structure attributes (lft, rgt, level). It uses Doctrine ORM mappings and implements NestedSetInterface for hierarchical data management.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: Entity class representing an organizational subunit, integrating nested set hierarchy functionalities and ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the subunit.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the subunit.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subunit.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the subunit.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Gets the unit identifier associated with the subunit.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unit identifier for the subunit.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the subunit.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the subunit.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Gets the left value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the left value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Gets the right value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the right value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of this node within the hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the hierarchical level of this node.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the node object that manages hierarchical positioning.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Assigns a NodeInterface object to this subunit.
